crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

translations.web: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
translations.bsb: So Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
translations.asv: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
